exam.exam_name: UPSC Indian Forest Service Examination (UPSC IFoS Main Examination)
exam.conducting_body: Union Public Service Commission (UPSC), New Delhi

source_evidence.captured_wording: The photograph uploaded by the candidate should not be more than 10 days old from the start of the online application process. The name of the candidate and the date on which the photograph was taken must be clearly mentioned on the photograph. The candidate's face should occupy 3/4th of the space in the photograph.
source_evidence.document_title: Examination Notice No. 06/2024-IFS: Indian Forest Service Examination, 2024
source_evidence.section_name: Appendix-II: Instructions to Candidates for OTR and Form Filling

unsupported_requirement_reasons: The body requires the candidate's name and/or the photograph date printed on the image. The engine has no text-rendering capability, so the photograph is produced correctly sized and composed but without the imprint, which the candidate must add before uploading.

image_requirements.file_size.evidence_reference: Examination Notice No. 06/2024-IFS: Indian Forest Service Examination, 2024 - Appendix-II: Instructions to Candidates for OTR and Form Filling (https://upsc.gov.in/sites/default/files/Notice-IFSP-2024-Engl-140224.pdf)
image_requirements.file_size.reasoning: Byte ceiling converted from the published figure using 1 KB = 1000 bytes. No body in the researched set defines the unit, and the decimal reading is the smaller of the two, so a file satisfying it also satisfies a 1024-byte reading.

image_requirements.dimensions.evidence_reference: Examination Notice No. 06/2024-IFS: Indian Forest Service Examination, 2024 - Appendix-II: Instructions to Candidates for OTR and Form Filling (https://upsc.gov.in/sites/default/files/Notice-IFSP-2024-Engl-140224.pdf)
image_requirements.dimensions.reasoning: Pixel dimensions transcribed from the cited source.

image_requirements.formats.preferred_for.reasoning: The body lists permitted formats without naming a preference. JPEG is selected from the permitted list; JPG and JPEG name the same format, so this chooses a spelling rather than a format.

image_requirements.composition.crop_prof.reasoning: One composition is used for every examination: the tightest crop that keeps hair, ears and the chin/beard boundary intact. No researched body publishes a coverage maximum this would breach, and all published minima are cleared by it.
